cards.headline: The tape: a broad bid, 69% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX +0.77% · WTI -2.12% · Brent -0.92% · NatGas +1.11%. 69% of 67 energy names are green — a broad bid. Grid, Storage & Electrification is doing the heavy lifting at +1.48%.

cards.headline: Grid, Storage & Electrification leads, Nuclear & Uranium lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Grid, Storage & Electrification at +1.48%; weakest is Nuclear & Uranium at -0.81%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: SEDG is the standout at +6.03%
cards.body: Leaders: SEDG +6.03%, BE +5.41%, NXT +4.55%, VRT +2.72%, WFRD +2.59%. Laggards: BWXT -2.39%, LNG -2.11%, NRG -1.55%, VST -1.33%.
